$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/ops.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only: apps/factory-api's Security & health (B-W2a-36) records restore drills through command() and reads them (the panel, the due reminder). The floor and portal/link sessions read and write nothing here. RestoreDrill is append-only (`@append-only`; the …_platform_w2a_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login): a mistake is a new drill. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

RestoreDrill.about: The office records a restore drill with its checksums, result and evidence, and reads them; nobody changes or removes one.
